1.english_reference: And when the seventh month was come

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּגַּע֙ הַ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ שְּׁבִיעִ֔י
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἔφθασεν ὁ μὴν ὁ ἕβδομος
traditions.VUL: Iamque vénerat mensis séptimus ,
traditions.KJV: And when the seventh month was come ,

1.english_reference: and the children of Israel [ were ] in the cities

traditions.WLC: וּ בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֶּ עָרִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ Ἰσραὴλ ἐν πόλεσιν αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et erant fílii Israel in civitátibus suis :
traditions.KJV: and the children of Israel [ were ] in the cities ,

1.english_reference: the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּאָסְפ֥וּ הָ עָ֛ם כְּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד אֶל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνήχθη ὁ λαὸς ὡς ἀνὴρ εἷς εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: congregátus est ergo pópulus quasi vir unus in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem .

2.english_reference: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and his brethren the priests

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּקָם֩ יֵשׁ֨וּעַ בֶּן יֽוֹצָדָ֜ק וְ אֶחָ֣י ו הַ כֹּהֲנִ֗ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέστη ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ἰωσεδὲκ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: Et surréxit Iósue fílius Iósedec , et fratres eius sacerdótes ,
traditions.KJV: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and his brethren the priests ,

2.english_reference: and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and his brethren

traditions.WLC: וּ זְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בֶּן שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל֙ וְ אֶחָ֔י
traditions.VUL: et Zoróbabel fílius Saláthiel , et fratres eius ,
traditions.KJV: and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and his brethren ,

2.english_reference: and builded the altar of the God of Israel

traditions.WLC: ו וַ יִּבְנ֕וּ אֶת מִזְבַּ֖ח אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν τὸ θυσιαστήριον θεοῦ Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: et ædificavérunt altáre Dei Israel
traditions.KJV: and builded the altar of the God of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: לְ הַעֲל֤וֹת עָלָי ו֙ עֹל֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: τοῦ ἀνενέγκαι ἐπ᾽ αὐτὸ ὁλοκαυτώσεις
traditions.VUL: ut offérrent in eo holocautómata ,
traditions.KJV: to offer burnt offerings thereon ,

2.english_reference: as [ it is ] written in the law of Moses the man of God

traditions.WLC: כַּ כָּת֕וּב בְּ תוֹרַ֖ת מֹשֶׁ֥ה אִישׁ הָ אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: κατὰ τὰ γεγραμμένα ἐν νόμῳ Μωυσῆ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ θεοῦ .
traditions.VUL: sicut scriptum est in lege Móysi viri Dei :
traditions.KJV: as [ it is ] written in the law of Moses the man of God .

3.english_reference: And they set the altar upon his bases

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּכִ֤ינוּ הַ מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ עַל מְכ֣וֹנֹתָ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ θυσιαστήριον ἐπὶ τὴν ἑτοιμασίαν αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: collocavérunt autem altáre Dei super bases suas ,
traditions.KJV: And they set the altar upon his bases ;

3.english_reference: for fear [ was ] upon them because of the people of those countries

traditions.WLC: ו כִּ֚י בְּ אֵימָ֣ה עֲלֵי הֶ֔ם מֵ עַמֵּ֖י הָ אֲרָצ֑וֹת
traditions.VUL: deterréntibus eos per circúitum pópulis terrárum :
traditions.KJV: for fear [ was ] upon them because of the people of those countries :

3.english_reference: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD

traditions.WLC: ו יעל עָלָ֤י ו עֹלוֹת֙ לַֽ יהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέβη ἐπ᾽ αὐτὸ ὁλοκαύτωσις τῷ κυρίῳ
traditions.VUL: et obtulérunt super illud holocáustum Dómino
traditions.KJV: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD , [ even ]

3.english_reference: [ even ] burnt offerings morning and evening

traditions.WLC: עֹל֖וֹת לַ בֹּ֥קֶר וְ לָ עָֽרֶב
traditions.LXX: τὸ πρωὶ καὶ εἰς ἑσπέραν .
traditions.VUL: mane et véspere :
traditions.KJV: burnt offerings morning and evening .

4.english_reference: They kept also the feast of tabernacles , as [ it is ] written

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת חַ֥ג הַ סֻּכּ֖וֹת כַּ כָּת֑וּב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησαν τὴν ἑορτὴν τῶν σκηνῶν κατὰ τὸ γεγραμμένον ,
traditions.VUL: fecerúntque solemnitátem tabernaculórum , sicut scriptum est ,
traditions.KJV: They kept also the feast of tabernacles , as [ it is ] written ,

4.english_reference: and [ offered ] the daily burnt offerings by number

traditions.WLC: וְ עֹלַ֨ת י֤וֹם בְּ יוֹם֙ בְּ מִסְפָּ֔ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁλοκαυτώσεις ἡμέραν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐν ἀριθμῷ
traditions.VUL: et holocáustum diébus síngulis per órdinem
traditions.KJV: and [ offered ] the daily burnt offerings by number ,

4.english_reference: according to the custom , as the duty of every day required

traditions.WLC: כְּ מִשְׁפַּ֖ט דְּבַר י֥וֹם בְּ יוֹמֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὡς ἡ κρίσις , λόγον ἡμέρας ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ·
traditions.VUL: secúndum præcéptum opus diéi in die suo .
traditions.KJV: according to the custom , as the duty of every day required ;

5.english_reference: And afterward [ offered ] the continual burnt offering

traditions.WLC: וְ אַחֲרֵי כֵ֞ן עֹלַ֤ת תָּמִיד֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ μετὰ τοῦτο ὁλοκαυτώσεις ἐνδελεχισμοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Et post hæc holocáustum iuge ,
traditions.KJV: And afterward [ offered ] the continual burnt offering ,

5.english_reference: both of the new moons , and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated

traditions.WLC: וְ לֶ֣ חֳדָשִׁ֔ים וּ לְ כָל מוֹעֲדֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה הַ מְקֻדָּשִׁ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰς τὰς νουμηνίας καὶ εἰς πάσας ἑορτὰς τὰς ἡγιασμένας ,
traditions.VUL: tam in caléndis quam in univérsis solemnitátibus Dómini , quæ erant consecrátæ ,
traditions.KJV: both of the new moons , and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated ,

5.english_reference: and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the LORD

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ כֹ֛ל מִתְנַדֵּ֥ב נְדָבָ֖ה לַ יהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ παντὶ ἑκουσιαζομένῳ ἑκούσιον τῷ κυρίῳ .
traditions.VUL: et in ómnibus in quibus ultro offerebátur munus Dómino .
traditions.KJV: and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the LORD .

6.english_reference: From the first day of the seventh month

traditions.WLC: מִ יּ֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ לַ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ שְּׁבִיעִ֔י
traditions.LXX: ἐν ἡμέρᾳ μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ ἑβδόμου
traditions.VUL: A primo die mensis séptimi
traditions.KJV: From the first day of the seventh month

6.english_reference: began they to offer burnt offerings unto the LORD

traditions.WLC: הֵחֵ֕לּוּ לְ הַעֲל֥וֹת עֹל֖וֹת לַ יהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ἤρξαντο ἀναφέρειν ὁλοκαυτώσεις τῷ κυρίῳ ·
traditions.VUL: cœpérunt offérre holocáustum Dómino :
traditions.KJV: began they to offer burnt offerings unto the LORD .

6.english_reference: But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not [ yet ] laid

traditions.WLC: וְ הֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א יֻסָּֽד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁ οἶκος Κυρίου οὐκ ἐθεμελιώθη .
traditions.VUL: porro templum Dei nondum fundátum erat .
traditions.KJV: But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not [ yet ] laid .

7.english_reference: They gave money also unto the masons , and to the carpenters

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֨תְּנוּ כֶ֔סֶף לַ חֹצְבִ֖ים וְ לֶ חָרָשִׁ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκαν ἀργύριον τοῖς λατόμοις καὶ τοῖς τέκτοσιν ,
traditions.VUL: Dedérunt autem pecúnias látomis et cæmentáriis :
traditions.KJV: They gave money also unto the masons , and to the carpenters ;

7.english_reference: and meat , and drink , and oil , unto them of Zidon , and to them of Tyre

traditions.WLC: וּ מַאֲכָ֨ל וּ מִשְׁתֶּ֜ה וָ שֶׁ֗מֶן לַ צִּֽדֹנִים֙ וְ לַ צֹּרִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ βρώματα καὶ ποτὰ καὶ ἔλαιον τοῖς Σηδαμεὶν καὶ τοῖς Σωρεὶν
traditions.VUL: cibum quoque , et potum , et óleum Sidóniis Tyriísque ,
traditions.KJV: and meat , and drink , and oil , unto them of Zidon , and to them of Tyre ,

7.english_reference: to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa

traditions.WLC: לְ הָבִיא֩ עֲצֵ֨י אֲרָזִ֤ים מִן הַ לְּבָנוֹן֙ אֶל יָ֣ם יָפ֔וֹא
traditions.LXX: ἐνέγκαι ξύλα κέδρινα ἀπὸ τοῦ Λιβάνου πρὸς θάλασσαν Ἰόππης ,
traditions.VUL: ut deférrent ligna cédrina de Líbano ad mare Ioppe ,
traditions.KJV: to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa ,

7.english_reference: according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia

traditions.WLC: כְּ רִשְׁי֛וֹן כּ֥וֹרֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ פָּרַ֖ס עֲלֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: κατ᾽ ἐπιχώρησιν Κύρου βασιλέως Περσῶν ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς .
traditions.VUL: iuxta quod præcéperat Cyrus rex Persárum eis .
traditions.KJV: according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia .

8.english_reference: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem , in the second month

traditions.WLC: וּ בַ שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ שֵּׁנִ֗ית לְ בוֹאָ֞ ם אֶל בֵּ֤ית הָֽ אֱלֹהִים֙ לִ יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בַּ חֹ֖דֶשׁ הַ שֵּׁנִ֑י
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ δευτέρῳ τοῦ ἐλθεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ , ἐν μηνὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ ,
traditions.VUL: Anno autem secúndo advéntus eórum ad templum Dei in Ierúsalem , mense secúndo ,
traditions.KJV: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem , in the second month ,

8.english_reference: began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites , and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: הֵחֵ֡לּוּ זְרֻבָּבֶ֣ל בֶּן שְׁ֠אַלְתִּיאֵל וְ יֵשׁ֨וּעַ בֶּן יֽוֹצָדָ֜ק וּ שְׁאָ֥ר אֲחֵי הֶ֣ם הַ כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֗ם וְ כָל הַ בָּאִים֙ מֵ הַ שְּׁבִ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֔ם
traditions.LXX: ἤρξατο Ζοροβαβὲλ ὁ τοῦ Σαλαθιὴλ καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ἰωσεδὲκ καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι τῶν ἀδελφῶν οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐρχόμενοι ἀπὸ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: cœpérunt Zoróbabel fílius Saláthiel , et Iósue fílius Iósedec , et réliqui de frátribus eórum sacerdótes , et Levítæ , et omnes qui vénerant de captivitáte in Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites , and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem ;

8.english_reference: and appointed the Levites , from twenty years old and upward

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעֲמִ֣ידוּ אֶת הַ לְוִיִּ֗ם מִ בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ מַ֔עְלָ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστησαν τοὺς Λευείτας ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω
traditions.VUL: et constituérunt Levítas a vigínti annis et supra ,
traditions.KJV: and appointed the Levites , from twenty years old and upward ,

8.english_reference: to set forward the work of the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: לְ נַצֵּ֖חַ עַל מְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ τὰ ἔργα Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: ut urgérent opus Dómini .
traditions.KJV: to set forward the work of the house of the LORD .

9.english_reference: Then stood Jeshua [ with ] his sons and his brethren , Kadmiel and his sons , the sons of Judah , together

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעֲמֹ֣ד יֵשׁ֡וּעַ בָּנָ֣י ו וְ֠ אֶחָי ו קַדְמִיאֵ֨ל וּ בָנָ֤י ו בְּנֵֽי יְהוּדָה֙ כְּ אֶחָ֔ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστη Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ , Καδμιὴλ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ υἱοὶ Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: Stetítque Iósue et fílii eius , et fratres eius , Cédmihel , et fílii eius , et fílii Iuda , quasi vir unus ,
traditions.KJV: Then stood Jeshua [ with ] his sons and his brethren , Kadmiel and his sons , the sons of Judah , together ,

9.english_reference: to set forward the workmen in the house of God

traditions.WLC: לְ נַצֵּ֛חַ עַל עֹשֵׂ֥ה הַ מְּלָאכָ֖ה בְּ בֵ֣ית הָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ τοὺς ποιοῦντας τὰ ἔργα ἐν οἴκῳ τοῦ θεοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: ut instárent super eos qui faciébant opus in templo Dei :
traditions.KJV: to set forward the workmen in the house of God :

9.english_reference: the sons of Henadad , [ with ] their sons and their brethren the Levites

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵי֙ חֵֽנָדָ֔ד בְּנֵי הֶ֥ם וַ אֲחֵי הֶ֖ם הַ לְוִיִּֽם
traditions.LXX: υἱοὶ Ἡναάδ , υἱοὶ αὐτῶν καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν οἱ Λευεῖται .
traditions.VUL: fílii Hénadad , et fílii eórum , et fratres eórum Levítæ .
traditions.KJV: the sons of Henadad , [ with ] their sons and their brethren the Levites .

10.english_reference: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ יִסְּד֥וּ הַ בֹּנִ֖ים אֶת הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐθεμελίωσαν τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου ·
traditions.VUL: Fundáto ígitur a cæmentáriis templo Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD ,

10.english_reference: they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעֲמִידוּ֩ הַ כֹּהֲנִ֨ים מְלֻבָּשִׁ֜ים בַּ חֲצֹֽצְר֗וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς ἐστολισμένοι ἐν σάλπιγξιν
traditions.VUL: stetérunt sacerdótes in ornátu suo cum tubis :
traditions.KJV: they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets ,

10.english_reference: and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֤ם בְּנֵֽי אָסָף֙ בַּֽ מְצִלְתַּ֔יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται υἱοὶ Ἀσὰφ
traditions.VUL: et Levítæ fílii Asaph in cýmbalis ,
traditions.KJV: and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals ,

traditions.WLC: לְ הַלֵּל֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: τοῦ αἰνεῖν τὸν κύριον
traditions.VUL: ut laudárent Deum
traditions.KJV: to praise the LORD ,

10.english_reference: after the ordinance of David king of Israel

traditions.WLC: עַל יְדֵ֖י דָּוִ֥יד מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ χεῖρας Δαυεὶδ βασιλέως Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: per manus David regis Israel .
traditions.KJV: after the ordinance of David king of Israel .

11.english_reference: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַֽ֠ יַּעֲנוּ בְּ הַלֵּ֨ל וּ בְ הוֹדֹ֤ת לַֽ יהוָה֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν ἐν αἴνῳ καὶ ἀνθομολογήσει τῷ κυρίῳ
traditions.VUL: Et concinébant in hymnis , et confessióne Dómino :
traditions.KJV: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD ;

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב
traditions.LXX: Ὃτι ἀγαθόν ,
traditions.VUL: Quóniam bonus ,
traditions.KJV: because [ he is ] good ,

11.english_reference: for his mercy [ endureth ] for ever toward Israel

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי לְ עוֹלָ֥ם חַסְדּ֖ וֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius super Israel .
traditions.KJV: for his mercy [ endureth ] for ever toward Israel .

11.english_reference: And all the people shouted with a great shout

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל הָ עָ֡ם הֵרִיעוּ֩ תְרוּעָ֨ה גְדוֹלָ֤ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἐσήμαινον φωνὴν μεγάλην
traditions.VUL: Omnis quoque pópulus vociferabátur clamóre magno
traditions.KJV: And all the people shouted with a great shout ,

traditions.WLC: בְ הַלֵּל֙ לַֽ יהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: αἰνεῖν τῷ κυρίῳ
traditions.VUL: in laudándo Dóminum ,
traditions.KJV: when they praised the LORD ,

11.english_reference: because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid

traditions.WLC: עַ֖ל הוּסַ֥ד בֵּית יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ θεμελιώσει οἴκου Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: eo quod fundátum esset templum Dómini .
traditions.KJV: because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid .

12.english_reference: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers , [ who were ] ancient men

traditions.WLC: וְ רַבִּ֡ים מֵ הַ כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ הַ לְוִיִּם֩ וְ רָאשֵׁ֨י הָ אָב֜וֹת הַ זְּקֵנִ֗ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ πολλοὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἱερέων καὶ τῶν Λευειτῶν καὶ ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν οἱ πρεσβύτεροι
traditions.VUL: Plúrimi étiam de sacerdótibus et Levítis , et príncipes patrum , et senióres ,
traditions.KJV: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers , [ who were ] ancient men ,

12.english_reference: that had seen the first house

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֨ר רָא֜וּ אֶת הַ בַּ֤יִת הָֽ רִאשׁוֹן֙
traditions.LXX: οἵ εἴδοσαν τὸν οἶκον τὸν πρῶτον
traditions.VUL: qui víderant templum prius
traditions.KJV: that had seen the first house ,

12.english_reference: when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes

traditions.WLC: בְּ יָסְד֔ וֹ זֶ֤ה הַ בַּ֨יִת֙ בְּ עֵ֣ינֵי הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: ἐν θεμελιώσει αὐτοῦ , καὶ τοῦτον τὸν οἶκον ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: cum fundátum esset , et hoc templum in óculis eórum ,
traditions.KJV: when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes ,

traditions.WLC: בֹּכִ֖ים בְּ ק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל
traditions.LXX: ἔκλαιον φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ,
traditions.VUL: flebant voce magna :
traditions.KJV: wept with a loud voice ;

12.english_reference: and many shouted aloud for joy

traditions.WLC: וְ רַבִּ֛ים בִּ תְרוּעָ֥ה בְ שִׂמְחָ֖ה לְ הָרִ֥ים קֽוֹל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὄχλος ἐν σημασίᾳ μετ᾽ εὐφροσύνης τοῦ ὑψῶσαι ᾠδήν .
traditions.VUL: et multi vociferántes in lætítia , elevábant vocem .
traditions.KJV: and many shouted aloud for joy :

13.english_reference: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֣ין הָ עָ֗ם מַכִּירִים֙ ק֚וֹל תְּרוּעַ֣ת הַ שִּׂמְחָ֔ה לְ ק֖וֹל בְּכִ֣י הָ עָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἦν λαὸς ἐπιγινώσκων φωνὴν σημασίας τῆς εὐφροσύνης ἀπὸ τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ κλαυθμοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Nec póterat quisquam agnóscere vocem clamóris lætántium , et vocem fletus pópuli :
traditions.KJV: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people :

13.english_reference: for the people shouted with a loud shout

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י הָ עָ֗ם מְרִיעִים֙ תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ὁ λαὸς ἐκραύγασεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ,
traditions.VUL: commístim enim pópulus vociferabátur clamóre magno ,
traditions.KJV: for the people shouted with a loud shout ,

13.english_reference: and the noise was heard afar off

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ קּ֥וֹל נִשְׁמַ֖ע עַד לְ מֵ רָחֽוֹק
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἠκούετο ἕως ἀπὸ μακρόθεν .
traditions.VUL: et vox audiebátur procul .
traditions.KJV: and the noise was heard afar off .
